svg.text: Layout B: Hand all becomes a split button with one shared confirm
Hand all keeps its place; a caret (Alt+H) lists targets: the bot, Orca sessions (linked first, then possible) and a new worktree on the PR head.
One confirm serves every target. Its Hand to selector reshapes the form: bot shows one command per thread, Orca shows one combined prompt.
Sample: acme-co/orders-api #365, 3 unresolved review-bot findings plus 1 person's thread. Findings 1 and 2 are fixture text; finding 3 (webhook job) is synthetic.
Desktop 1660x870, 1:1 crop around the middle pane (480 wide)
One split button, sub moves under the headline.
